g.aria-label: Multi-GPU Scaling Conventions: Strong Scaling vs. Weak Scaling
Harder to scale at large k:
compute shrinks while comm S stays
Weak-Scaling Speedup Condition (k = 2): t_dev(b) > 2·h_step and t_dev(b) > α + S·β_link
LeNet on 2 GPUs: b = 256 slows down (host-bound); b = 32,768 reaches 1.9× speedup!
